acceptanceCriteria: BUG-0102: a pack.json no loaded pack resolves to exempts nothing; its fixtures/<slug>/(violating|passing)/<case>/ files stay judged by every rule at verify, serve, the L3 hooks and size rules
Pack case data under a built-in pack root of this workspace or a config.packs path root is still exempt
Pack roots are computed once per command from the loaded config; a config that fails to load exempts nothing
diagnosis: BUG-0102. Reproduced by reading kernel/pack-case.ts: isPackCasePath probes fs.exists('<pack>/pack.json') for any <pack>/fixtures/<slug>/(violating|passing)/<case>/ path, so an agent-written pack.json plus fixtures files escape verify, serve, L3 hooks and size rules. Root cause: the predicate treats presence of pack.json on disk as proof of a loaded pack, but SPEC 4.4.1 confines it to the root of a pack Codictator loads (built-in pack directory or config.packs path). Fix: the predicate takes the loaded pack roots computed once from the loaded config.
